title: Other relief available.
bodyText: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed as preventing the plaintiff in any action from obtaining relief upon process provided by any provision of law.
bodyHtml: §287-47  Other relief available.  Nothing in this chapter shall be construed as preventing the plaintiff in any action from obtaining relief upon process provided by any provision of law. [L 1949, c 393, pt of §1; RL 1955, §160-125; HRS §287-47]
